claims.gist: Sysdig and Datadog detected about half of the Kubernetes events in my evaluation
My CSPM ignored most developer Kubernetes actions, with 99%+ going undetected
Forrester errs in saying CDR does not exist by making cloud too broad
XDR, like CNAPP, spread across too many log sources without succeeding
CDR is tying eBPF and cloud logs into meaningful exploit stories for Kubernetes
Agentless scanning fails for workloads that have no EBS volumes
eBPF agents fail on unsupported operating systems

thesis: CDR is real: it ties eBPF and cloud logs into Kubernetes exploit stories, which CNAPP tools largely miss.
